{{Quote|I attended the Academy, and I have nothing negative to say about the Imperial training program, but nothing can prepare you for true space combat. You need to know your life is on the line, that your next move could destroy your enemy or put you directly in his firing vector.|Flight Leader Trel Skutu|<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>}}
'''Trel "Scourge" Skutu''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE pilot]] and [[Flight leader/Legends|flight leader]], going by the callsign of "Scourge". Despite his dislike for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Skutu admitted he respected the aggressiveness and ability of Rebel [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition" />
